# VM

> A 32-bit Alpine Linux development guest running in the v86 browser emulator,
> with optional full IPv4 networking and gateway-free browser RPC tools.

Canonical documentation:

- [Guest tools reference](https://fapstaff.com/docs/guest-tools.html): Responsive command reference with syntax, examples, limits, exit behavior, and troubleshooting for vmfetch, vmclip, vmexport, vmgithub, vmai, vmllm, vmlang, and file import.
- [Agent instructions](https://fapstaff.com/AGENTS.md): Operational constraints and rules for coding agents working in the guest.
- [Deep Agents coding agent](https://fapstaff.com/docs/deep-agent.html): Responsive guide to native planning, filesystem, shell, subagents, skills, approval boundary, and limits.
- [Browser bridge](https://fapstaff.com/network/docs/host-bridge.md): Architecture, browser security model, and bridge limitations.
- [IPv4 gateway](https://fapstaff.com/network/README.md): Linux TAP, DHCP, DNS, NAT, secure sessions, deployment, and the gateway-free in-page tcpip.js transport with its three network modes.
- [Project README](https://fapstaff.com/README.md): Artifacts, hosting requirements, and known issues.

Important constraints:

- v86 is 32-bit x86; x86-64 binaries cannot execute.
- vmfetch uses browser fetch and is subject to CORS and mixed-content policy.
- Reaching the Internet requires the external gateway. DHCP, DNS, ICMP, TCP, and
  UDP between the guest and the browser tab additionally work with no gateway at
  all, in the `local` and `hybrid` network modes, where an in-page lwIP stack
  puts the page on the guest LAN.
- vmllm uses the VM's built-in page-local WebGPU LiteRT-LM provider; it does not run inference inside the guest and requires no extension.
- Over the serial bridge, browser-import and export files are limited to 8 MiB and vmfetch responses to 16 MiB. The socket-backed `vmlan` command has no such cap where a browser LAN is present.
- Run Deep Agents inside the guest with `vmlang 'TASK'`. It maps `/` to `/root/project`; reads are automatic, while mutations and all shell commands require confirmation.
- Optional AutoBro pairing adds authenticated browser automation. Session-only YOLO mode is active by default, so use `vmlang yolo off` when per-operation approvals are required.
